# Skoci — Ultra-lightweight Agent-Native Deployment Platform
> Self-hosted deploy platform: AI agents deploy, humans validate via dashboard, apps run on user VPS.

## Key Facts
- Single Rust binary (<20MB idle RAM target, zero extra daemons)
- Zero shell string interpolation (safe against prompt injection)
- CLI & MCP tools return structured JSON with {code, message, fix} error format
- Secrets are encrypted at rest with ChaCha20-Poly1305 and never returned to model context
- Policy is built-in to the server; production actions and restores require human approval
- Zero SSH required after initial setup: all agent operations use scoped HTTPS tokens

## Exit Codes
- 0: Success
- 1: General error (action failed, build failed, invalid config)
- 2: Approval pending/required (production deploy, database restore, app delete)
- 3: Authentication / authorization error (unauthorized, scope_violation, rate_limited)

## Agent Rules & Guidelines
1. Always run commands with `--json` for machine-parsable outputs.
2. In case of error, inspect `error.code`, read the `error.fix` recommendation, and execute the suggested fix.
3. Never use or request SSH access after initial server setup. Connect using `skoci connect --server <url> --token <token>`.
4. Never print, log, or echo tokens (`sk_agent_*`, `sk_master_*`).
5. When promoting to production (`skoci promote "<reason>"`), inform the human user of the `request_id` for approval on the dashboard or CLI.
6. The project build always executes on the server inside Docker. The local machine does not require Docker.

## Agent Workflow
1. Connect: `skoci connect --server https://skoci.<base-domain> --token sk_agent_<app>_<hex>`
2. Initialize: `skoci init` (generates `skoci.yaml`, `Dockerfile`, `.dockerignore` if missing)
3. Configure: Adjust `skoci.yaml` (`app`, `run.port`, `domains`, `services`).
4. Set Secrets: `skoci secret set <KEY> <VALUE>` (encrypted on host)
5. Deploy to Preview: `skoci deploy --env preview --json`
6. Verify: Check health check, URLs, and smoke test status
7. Promote to Production: `skoci promote "<reason>" --json` (returns request ID for human approval)
8. Monitor: `skoci status --json` and `skoci logs --json`

## CLI Commands Reference
- `skoci connect --server <url> --token <token>`
- `skoci init [--app <name>]`
- `skoci deploy [--env preview|production] [--detach] [--commit <sha>]`
- `skoci watch <deployment_id>`
- `skoci deployments [--app <app>] [--limit 20]`
- `skoci status [<app>]`
- `skoci logs [<app>] [--env <env>] [--tail 100]`
- `skoci secret set <KEY> <VALUE>`
- `skoci secret list`
- `skoci promote "<reason>" [--version <v>]`
- `skoci approvals`
- `skoci approve <request_id>` / `skoci reject <request_id>` (admin only)
- `skoci rollback [--env preview] [--to <version>]`
- `skoci doctor`
- `skoci db backup [service=db]`
- `skoci db list`
- `skoci db restore <backup_id> [service=db]` (requires approval)
- `skoci app delete [<app>]` (requires approval)
- `skoci token create --app <app> [--name <name>]` (admin only)
- `skoci token list --app <app>` (admin only)
- `skoci token revoke --app <app> --name <name>` (admin only)
- `skoci agent-guide`
